name: Sydney Symphony Orchestra Under 35s tickets
summary: Up to 15% off single tickets and $55 subscription tickets for people under 35 at Sydney Symphony Orchestra concerts.
key: Up to 15% off full price tickets, and Series Pack subscriptions at $55 per ticket for under 35s.

evidence.quote: Under 35s Tickets are available for people under the age of 35.
